notes.title: The Sojourn: A Brand New Update for a Smoother Journey
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone, 
[/h3][p]Long time no see. We just wanted to check in to let everybody know that we [b]just released a brand-new update for The Sojourn[/b].

We recently noticed that there were compatibility issues that [b]stopped The Sojourn from running on Windows 11 in some instances.[/b] We’ve been working on a fix that’ll hopefully address those issues. We’re always dedicated to making our games as widely accessible as possible and we hope this fix will help future-proof and [b]preserve The Sojourn for next-gen players[/b].

On that note, we’re also currently [b]tinkering with some other ways of bringing the game to new players; but more on that in the future[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33286100/f3be4c99123e212d6a98e6a8bcc70aa4d6b8bdd1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Connect with us to stay up to date![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747657/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png"][/img]  [b]The Sojourn[/b] [/p][list][*][p]  [url="https://twitter.com/The_Sojourn"]Twitter[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.facebook.com/thesojourngame/"]Facebook[/url] [/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Iceberg Interactive[/b] [/p][list][*][p]  [url="http://www.twitter.com/iceberg_int"]Twitter[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.facebook.com/iceberginteractive"]Facebook[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.youtube.com/iceberginteractive"]YouTube[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.twitch.tv/iceberg_int"]Twitch[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/iceberg"]Steam Publisher Page[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Sojourn Steam release date reveal COMING SOON
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while! We're pleased to announce that the wait is almost over, and The Sojourn will be coming to Steam soon™

We'll be announcing the exact release date in the Iceberg Ahead show at Gamescom 2020 on [u]August 29th[/u]. To be notified the moment it goes live, make sure you join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/iceberginteractive]Iceberg Interactive Discord server[/url]!

We hope to see you there!
